title: NewRx
description: A new prescription for a pharmacy (the NCPDP SCRIPT NewRx equivalent, as JSON), for one signed prescription. Built at send time by the e-prescribing adapter from the prescription the outbox names (backend/app/modules/medications, build_new_rx), sent to the simulated pharmacy for the demo (D97, D99) and, later, mapped to NCPDP SCRIPT by the e-prescribing vendor's adapter (Q12). Minimum necessary: no SSN (D27, D43), no address, no phone, no gender, no diagnosis, no insurance. Dates and decimal amounts as strings (D40). x-phi marks each field's sensitivity as the API contract does (EXTENSIONS.md).

schemaVersion.description: This shape's version. A change that is not backward-compatible gets a new major version.

correlationId.description: Our prescription ID (NCPDP PrescriberOrderNumber). Every status reply echoes it and is filed against it. One NewRx per prescription, so the pharmacy drops a second message with the same `correlationId`.

createdAt.description: When the message was built (NCPDP Header SentTime), UTC.

signedAt.description: When the prescriber signed the prescription (NCPDP WrittenDate), UTC.

npi.description: The prescriber's National Provider Identifier, 10 digits.

patient.description: Who the prescription is for (NCPDP Patient): enough for the pharmacy to match its own record, nothing more.

name.description: The patient's legal name, never a preferred or previous one.

pharmacy.description: Where it goes (NCPDP Pharmacy), from the platform's pharmacy directory.

npi.description: The pharmacy's NPI, when the directory has it.

medication.description: What to dispense and how it is taken (NCPDP MedicationPrescribed).

rxnormCode.description: The RxNorm RxCUI of the drug, from RxNorm Current Prescribable Content (NCPDP DrugCoded, qualifier SCD or SBD). Absent when the prescriber wrote the drug as text only.

description.description: The drug as words (NCPDP DrugDescription): the RxNorm name, otherwise the prescriber's text.

value.description: The amount, a decimal string greater than zero with at most three fraction digits (the API allows up to 100000).

unit.description: The unit as the prescriber wrote it (`capsule`, `tablet`, `mL`); the vendor's adapter maps it to an NCPDP QuantityUnitOfMeasure code.

daysSupply.description: Days the quantity lasts (NCPDP DaysSupply). Absent when the prescriber left it out.

refills.description: Refills allowed after the first fill (NCPDP NumberOfRefills); 0 when none were written.

substitutionAllowed.description: Generic substitution allowed (NCPDP Substitutions: `0` when true, `1` (dispense as written) when false). True when the prescriber didn't say.

sig.description: The directions as written (NCPDP Sig, SigText).

deaSchedule.description: The DEA schedule of a controlled substance, from the RxNorm concept. Absent otherwise. Controlled substances need EPCS (Q19), which the demo doesn't do.

noteToPharmacist.description: The prescriber's note for the pharmacist (NCPDP Note, at most 210 characters).

Timestamp.description: An instant, RFC 3339, UTC with Z.

PersonName.description: A person's legal name (NCPDP LastName, FirstName, MiddleName).
